decisions.statement: The message's id and its thread come back beside those labels.
A relabelling naming neither an addition nor a removal is refused.
A label is named by its id rather than by the name that label is shown under.
The labels the message has after the change come back.
A relabelling that threw after Gmail took the change says the labels changed.

definition: the command putting label ids on one Gmail message and taking label ids off it
